title: Audit retention without the authority lock; prune command moves to Audit
summary: `Audit\Internal\JournalPruner` deletes expired journal rows by selected ids in short transactions on the storage connection, with per-batch deadlock retry, without the panel lock (knowledge/p3-execution#persistence prune model); `ChangePipeline::pruneJournal` is deleted; `AuditPruneCommand` moves to `Audit\Internal\Console\AuditPruneCommand` and is registered by `AuditServiceProvider`; core provider no longer imports it. Engine tests prove the interfering pairs on pgsql, mysql and mariadb.
why: Audit owns retention (architecture#operation-chains H, D19); core must not name audit_log (I2). Hard risk (architecture#risks): range deletes next to concurrent journal inserts on MySQL/MariaDB can deadlock or delete rows newer than the cutoff; the model fixes the selection rule, batch size and retry, and engine suites must show no lost row and no writer-visible deadlock.

include: `modules/audit/src/Internal/JournalPruner.php`: input panel id, StorageDescriptor (from supported API: the panel's writer schema/storage id + `AzGuard::storages()` or equivalent attributed accessor), cutoff; batches of 1000 ids, `DELETE … WHERE id IN (…)` in its own transaction per batch, retry the batch up to 3 times on SQLSTATE 40001/40P01 or MySQL 1213, returns the deleted count

`Laravel\Console\Commands\AuditPruneCommand` → `modules/audit/src/Internal/Console/AuditPruneCommand.php` (`Audit\Internal\Console\AuditPruneCommand`), options unchanged (`--panel --before --force`), reads `AuditOptions` from the panel; selects audited panels by the presence of `AuditOptions` (no plugin-id literal needed); registered by `AuditServiceProvider` in console

`Changes\ChangePipeline::pruneJournal` deleted; `AzGuardServiceProvider` no longer imports/registers the prune command; i2 entries (`ChangePipeline.php` audit_log, provider → AuditPruneCommand) and i4 entries of `AuditPruneCommand.php` removed

Engine tests (group `engines`) for every pair of the prune model table; feature tests for retention/`--before`/production `--force`; `commands.json` unchanged except the class move (regenerate only if the snapshot pins classes)
